sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October (15:00). Despite their league-leading position, Sandbach have picked up only one win in their last five outings (a loss most recently), so this fixture against struggling Alsager Town—who sit bottom with just 4 points and have won only once all season—offers a chance to return to winning ways. Sandbach then travel away to face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October (15:00), another opportunity to climb back into form as they bid to maintain their title challenge.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) face Dawley Town at home on Saturday before a midweek Wednesday fixture is avoided; they entertain Wednesfield Community on 10 October, a side showing mixed form with one recent win. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall on Saturday, a battle between two mid-table sides both with recent losses in their records. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth with 19 points and on a strong run, host struggling Widnes Town (bottom, 2 points) on Saturday—a mismatch on paper. Bilston Town (fifth, 17 points, in-form) visit Crewe on 10 October, while in-form Allscott Heath host Brereton Social on the same date. Barnton (15 points) face Dawley Town at home on 10 October in a mid-table clash. Shawbury United, winless in their last six, visit Alsager Town on 10 October in a basement battle. Market Drayton Town (12 points, inconsistent) host New Mills (14 points) on Saturday before facing Widnes Town away on 10 October. Cheadle Heath Nomads (7 points, struggling) host Telford Town (6 points, also struggling) on Saturday. Foley Meir entertain Bilston Town on Saturday 3 October. Crewe host Allscott Heath on Saturday 3 October. Brereton Social (11 points, recent loss) face a midweek trip to Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October before hosting Allscott Heath on 10 October.
